The Buot-Guila-Cabatbatan-Samboryo Trail Loop is a 12.75-kilometer loop through Buot-Taup, Guila-Guila, Babag Ridge, Dam-an, Cabatbatan, and Samboryo in Cebu City. I started near the suspended community bridge by the Barangay Buot-Taup Hall and initially followed the road toward Guila-Guila before climbing toward Babag Ridge and continuing through the mountain sections. <\/p>\n\n\n\n

About 30% of the route was trail and 70% unpaved or concrete road, with moderate shade and many stores near the communities. I did this hike in August 2026 on a cloudy-sunny morning, and the trail was dry, with very few insects and almost no human traffic once I reached the high mountain sections.<\/p>\n\n\n
